issues.title: No trading experience awarded when shift-clicking a full trade slot with villagers in Minecraft 26.2 Fabric server
issues.body:
Mod version: fabric-26.2-26.2.1
Minecraft version: 26.2
Loader: Fabric
Server: Dedicated server (single-player / multiplayer – both affected)

When trading with a villager, if I use Shift + left-click to instantly buy/sell the entire stack of a trade slot (i.e., perform a single transaction that consumes all available trades in that slot), no trading experience (XP) is awarded at all.

In vanilla Minecraft, shift-clicking a trade slot still gives the normal experience orbs for each completed trade cycle (the same as repeatedly clicking the slot one by one). The experience should be granted for every actual trade operation performed, regardless of whether it is done via shift-click.


Steps to reproduce:

1.Find a villager with an available trade (e.g., farmer buying wheat).
2.Have enough items/emeralds to perform multiple trades from that slot.
3.Shift+click the trade slot to perform all available trades at once.
4.Observe that no XP orbs drop and the experience bar does not increase.
5.(For comparison) Click the same trade slot one by one without shift – XP is awarded correctly.

Expected behavior:
Shift-clicking should grant the same total experience as performing the same number of trades individually.

Actual behavior:
Zero experience is granted.

issues.title: PickupXp event value changes have no effect
issues.body:
Bloodmagic adds both a way of increasing the xp you pick up and a way of storing the xp directly to an item instead of the player.
Both of these things use the PickupXp event to accomplish that and without clumps that generally works.
With clumps installed picking up an xp orb the event fires and first [the increasing](https://github.com/WayofTime/BloodMagic/blob/1.20.1/src/main/java/wayoftime/bloodmagic/util/handler/event/GenericHandler.java#L402) happens and the modified value is seen and used by the [listener for storing](https://github.com/WayofTime/BloodMagic/blob/1.20.1/src/main/java/wayoftime/bloodmagic/util/handler/event/GenericHandler.java#L440) which sets the value to 0 but the original xp is given to the player as well

To get the increasing you have to wear a full set of living armour and applying the "Experienced" upgrade to it (right clicking a upgrade tome with it while wearing the full armour) +15% per level.
To get the storing to work you just have to have a "Tome of Peritia" in your inventory.

From looking at the mixin class it seems like the actual xp count of the orb is stored using the ClumpedMap which isnt updated after the vanilla PickupXp event. Using the custom ValueEvent would probably solve the issue on bloodmagics side but fixing the forge event to behave normally seems like the "correct" thing to do

clumps 12.0.0.4
forge 47.3.0

You can manually modify the value by changing the `XP_Orb.clumpedMap.Value = count`. This means custom values can be stored only by changing the count, not the value (that would have to be 1).
The main issue is that when a function creates the orb, let's say like this:
```
scoreboard players set @s counter 100

summon experience_orb ~ ~ ~ {Value:1s,Count:1}
execute store result entity @e[type=experience_orb,distance=0,limit=1] Value short 1 run scoreboard players get @s counter
```

```
execute store result entity @e[type=experience_orb,distance=0,limit=1] clumpedMap.1 int 1 run scoreboard players get @s counter
```
it doesn't affect anything.
If the original vanilla approach is used, the Value and Count will stay the same, but if `clumpedMap` is changed by the function, it nullyfies the Value completely, despite working as expected when the same command is executed by the user.

I would guess it could have something to do with changing the `clumpedMap` in the same tick it was created, but only because I have no idea what else could cause this.

issues.title: Clumps orbs cause a crash when colliding with "Advent of Ascension (Nevermine)" portals
issues.body:
**Mod Version**
I have tested the following combinations (on single and multiplayer)

1.15.2:
- Clumps (5.0.0 and 5.0.2.6)
- AoA (from 3.4.6 to 3.4.8)
- forge (31.2.48 and 31.2.50)

1.16.5 versions doesn't seems to be affected:
- Clumps 6.0.0.17
- AoA 3.5-beta-1
- forge 36.1.0

**Describe the bug**
When one or more experience orbs from the mod Clumps (entity type is clumps:xp_orb_big) collide with one of the AoA portals (entering the portals), a crash occurs immediately or in the next few seconds.
This issue is present with all the portals blocks and regardless of whether they are created through realmstones or picked and placed alone (creative inventory).
Here is a crash report: https://pastebin.com/tZ8Ga1xV (singleplayer)

**To Reproduce**
1. install:
    Forge 31.2.48
    Clumps-5.0.2.6
    AoA3-3.4.8
3. create or load a world in creative (just to reproduce faster, survival is affected too)
4. get a portal block from the search bar of the creative inventory / create a portal with realmstones
5. throw some bottles' o enchanting near/in the portals or drag an experience orb into the portal

**Screenshots**
The portal showed is the "Abyss Portal"
https://i.imgur.com/4x65v1h.png
https://i.imgur.com/w87dqqI.png
https://i.imgur.com/wGJHlAn.png

**Notes**
- An AoA nether portal causes a crash while a normal nether portal doesn't.
- It doesn't seems to matter the dimension in which the orb goes / comes from.
- I've tested with Minecraft original launcher and MultiMC.
- I haven't tried Forge 31.2.0 (recommended build) because AoA3-3.4.8 requires Forge 31.2.27
- **I've reported this issue to Advent of Ascension creators too.**

Other mods may be storing additional information in the NBT of the experience orb. For these mods it would be nice to have some events or systems in place to allow this data to be copied over to your EXP entity. 

1. EXPCloneEvent - This event would be sent out when you replace the old EXP orb with the Clump version. This would allow mods to subscribe and copy over the data they need.
2. EXPMergeEvent - This event would be used to handle when two Clumps EXP orbs would merge together. This event would allow for the data to be merged properly, or erased/canceled if the merge is not possible.
